speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy with feeding difficulties and abdominal distension. To understand what is happening inside, tell me if you have been vomiting, and if so, is the vomit green or yellow?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception.

The combination of an 8-month-old male with abdominal distension, feeding difficulties, and specifically pain (crying) exacerbated by palpation of the abdomen is highly suspicious for intussusception. I request an ultrasound of the abdomen to confirm this diagnosis.
